teaching_claim: A bounded finite display cannot certify BIBO stability because nearly coincident 100-sample prefixes can continue toward zero, persist, or grow; only the radius-below-one geometric tail is absolutely summable.

thumbnail.result: PASS: the common start at 1, endpoint order 0.906 < 1.000 < 1.104, and the verdict 'summable only for rho<1' remain distinguishable in both themes; the detailed sum rows recede but remain present.

numerical_contract.normalization: none; all series use the same axes and fixed scale
numerical_contract.logical_guard: The figure states that every displayed finite prefix is bounded; it never labels finite boundedness as stability. Stability is attached only to the finite infinite absolute sum for rho<1.

visual_contract.discrete_plot: Each of the three sequences uses 100 separate zero-length round/square-capped path marks at integer n; there are no connecting line or curve segments between samples.
visual_contract.shared_start: An outlined marker and direct 'all start at 1' label identify h[0]=1.
visual_contract.continuation: Three dashed arrows continue from the n=99 endpoints into directly labelled decay, persistence, and growth outcomes.
visual_contract.summaries: Three aligned cards show the exact rounded 100-sample partial absolute sums and the distinct infinite-tail verdicts.
visual_contract.main_verdict: A large green-outlined strip reads 'finite prefix: all bounded · infinite tail: summable only for rho<1'.

palette.currentColor: axes, ticks, rho=1 samples, persistent continuation, and all neutral text
palette.#5aa46a: finite infinite sum / BIBO-stable verdict only

visual_contract.non_color_cues: Every series is directly labelled with rho and its n=99 value; continuation directions, card headings, exact sums, and stable/not-BIBO-stable text duplicate all color meanings.

accessibility.labeling: aria-labelledby references a title and a full factual desc containing endpoints, partial sums, and the infinite-tail verdict
accessibility.theme: All neutral text and strokes use currentColor; light and dark renders were visually inspected
